QuestInfo.name: Shining Resistance Member Badge
QuestInfo.0: Claudine has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Claudine has given you a gift.

0.0: I've been waiting, #b#ho##k. There's not a single person in the Resistance who hasn't heard of your exploits. We use you to inspire the new recruits.
0.1: At this point, you're indispensable to the Resistance. To represent that, we've created an emblem to be worn only by you. This is a mark of your status among us. Please accept it, and wear it with pride.

no.0: This emblem was created specifically for you. Please don't refuse it.

yes.0: We will allow no one to oppress freedom. Your efforts will bear fruit in the future, mark my words. With you in our ranks, I truly believe in our people's future.
